messages:
harper: Heads-up: scheduling a short maintenance window for us-west3 heat-mitigate pool (rack uw3-12) 2026-08-05 04:00->05:00 UTC. Goal: NIC microcode + thermal threshold tune. We'll do single-node canary then 2-at-a-time if stable. ops-oncall pls ack.

diego: ack. Why the 2-at-a-time after canary? risk of thermal coupling?

harper: Correct. Recent heatwave spikes mean neighbor thermal coupling probability increased; doing 2-at-a-time keeps network and GPU throughput stable while limiting heat redistribution. Expect ~18% transient burstable capacity drop during cohorts.

maya: Recommend pre-warming KV prefixes and enabling short-lived overflow to west3-spare if queue depth >60%. Also run a pre-eviction sweep.

ops-oncall: On it. If any node rejoin >9m or p95 >30% baseline we stop. I'll monitor GPU temps, evictions, queue depth.

maint-bot: Maintenance window created: 2026-08-05T04:00:00Z -> 2026-08-05T05:00:00Z (ID: mw-1955554321). Notifications scheduled.

harper: Canary flow (add to runbook):
```
# canary flow
kubectl cordon uw3-12-03
kubectl drain uw3-12-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
apply-nic-fw --node uw3-12-03 --ver 1.5.0 --verify-checksum
thermal-tune --node uw3-12-03 --profile heatwave-1
reboot-node uw3-12-03 --wait 300
run-health-checks --node uw3-12-03 --checks net,pcie,gpu-temp,driver-logs
kubectl uncordon uw3-12-03
# observe 15m then proceed to 2-node cohorts
```

diego: KV warm commands to run after each uncordon:
```
west3-cache-seed --pool heat-mitigate --prefix "/embeddings" --workers 4
west3-cache-seed --pool heat-mitigate --prefix "/chat/hot" --workers 2
```

finance-bot: Estimated contingency cost if overflow used: ~$2,400 for 1h (preemptible + egress). Flagged to finance channel.

harper: Communication: post status banner T-30m, ping #customer-success T-15m, email top-6 tenants. Console note: "uw3 heat-mitigate maintenance". Runbook link will be posted here.

maya: After each cohort annotate nodes: `kubectl annotate node uw3-12-03 redwood/nic=1.5.0 redwood/thermal=heatwave-1`. Also collect `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi -q` to s3://redwood-ops/maint/uw3/1955554321/.

ops-oncall: I'll create temp dashboards and an alert if GPU temp >85C or rejoin time >9m. Standing by.

harper: Thanks all. If canary looks clean we may compress window to 45m; ops-oncall will confirm after first 20m. :white_check_mark:
